auth.selected: Connection-owned Authorization header containing the complete SERVICE_TOKEN_ID:SERVICE_TOKEN value
auth.official_openapi_model: The OpenAPI declares OAuth2 authorization-code security on every operation.
auth.official_service_token_model: The official service-token guide says all API endpoints require a service token and gives the exact TOKEN_ID:TOKEN_SECRET Authorization value.

source_decision.reason: PlanetScale exposes infrastructure databases, branches, deploy requests, and migration workflows rather than semantically honest user-work tasks, notes, or projects. The authority also does not prove a durable version plus deletion/tombstone contract for any such work entity, so no Source is claimed.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The query-pattern download has only a 302 success contract.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded the unrepresentable redirect capability and retained the status operation that returns the provider-authored download URL.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The OpenAPI server carries /v1 while all documentary path keys omit it.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Used an origin-only HTTP base, /v1 wire paths, and openapi_source.path_alias.wire_prefix=/v1.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Three query arrays use form/explode=false, while runtime arrays serialize as repeated keys.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Projected them to bounded comma-separated strings so one query key preserves the official CSV wire contract.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Cursor endpoints expose both forward and reverse controls, but automatic walking can certify only one direction safely.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Gateway-owned starting_after, ending_before, and limit; automatic traversal is explicitly forward-only, uses the official example's limit=50, invents no undocumented maximum, and cannot retain a conflicting reverse anchor.

audit_findings_folded.finding: All 43 request bodies omit requestBody.required despite mutation semantics.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Required a complete bounded JSON object body_raw for every documented body, allowing {} where provider defaults are intended.

audit_findings_folded.finding: One branch-change PATCH declares both a JSON 200 and an empty 204 success.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Made that operation's response schema accept either the documented object or null so an honest 204 cannot fail response validation.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Thirty path parameters named number are unbounded integer resource identifiers and could be rounded if admitted as JavaScript numbers.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Projected every unbounded integer path identifier to a validated exact decimal string; path interpolation preserves the literal digits without numeric conversion.

official_operations.exclusion_reason: The official operation declares only a 302 redirect success. The connection transport follows only same-origin redirects and rejects cross-origin download redirects before exposing a response, so the documented redirect cannot be represented as a reliable callable capability without weakening the credential-origin boundary. Use the report-status operation to obtain the provider-authored download URL.
